initiatives.name: Prisoners' Legal Services of New York
initiatives.description: Nonprofit law office providing free legal representation to people in New York State prisons, with offices in Albany, Buffalo, Ithaca, and Newburgh.

initiatives.name: F2L Network
initiatives.description: Sends commissary money and other support to incarcerated Black, Indigenous and people of color who are queer, trans or Two-Spirit in New York State prisons and NYC jails.

initiatives.name: Community Voices Heard (CVH)
initiatives.description: Black- and brown-led membership organization in New York organizing low-income New Yorkers on housing, public housing preservation, and economic justice.

initiatives.name: New York Civil Liberties Union
initiatives.description: New York state affiliate of the ACLU that works on civil liberties through litigation, policy advocacy, and organizing.

initiatives.name: Envision Freedom Fund
initiatives.description: Brooklyn-based fund that pays immigration bonds to free people from ICE detention in New York and helps them after release. Formerly the Brooklyn Community Bail Fund.

initiatives.name: Equality New York
initiatives.description: Equality New York (EQNY) is a grassroots advocacy organization that advances the lives of all LGBTQI+ New Yorkers and their families.

initiatives.name: New York Immigration Coalition
initiatives.description: Umbrella advocacy group of more than 200 immigrant and refugee organizations across New York State, working on immigrant rights, legal services, language access, and civic participation.

initiatives.name: Upstate NY Socialist Rifle Association
initiatives.description: We are the Upstate NY chapter of the Socialist Rifle Association.

initiatives.name: Upstate Anti-Fascist Coalition
initiatives.description: Grassroots anti-fascist group based in Glens Falls, with members in Salem, South Glens Falls and Saratoga. Holds rallies and joins solidarity pickets with Migrant Justice.

initiatives.name: Northern New York Coalition
initiatives.description: Massena-based coalition in New York's North Country that organizes protests and community events, including 2026 No Kings rallies in Massena and Ogdensburg.

initiatives.name: Housing Justice for All
initiatives.description: Statewide coalition of over 80 tenant, homeless and public housing groups from Brooklyn to Buffalo, working on tenant protections, eviction limits and affordable housing.

initiatives.name: Release Aging People in Prison (RAPP) Campaign
initiatives.description: New York campaign working to release older people from state prison, including support for the Elder Parole bill. Organizes with local groups statewide.

initiatives.name: DecrimNY
initiatives.description: Coalition of sex workers, legal aid and advocacy groups working to decriminalize sex work in New York and backing the Stop Violence in the Sex Trades Act.

initiatives.name: Osborne Association
initiatives.description: Nonprofit serving people and families affected by incarceration in New York, with court advocacy, family programs, reentry services and housing, plus offices across the state.
